llm.begin_message: Thanks for calling FixCall Appliance Repair, this is Grace. How can I help?

analysis_summary_prompt: Summarize this call in 2-3 sentences for the repair office. Include who called, the appliance and issue if relevant, and the outcome. Only use facts stated in the call. Do not invent details.

post_call_analysis_data.name: call_summary
post_call_analysis_data.description: Summarize the call in 2-3 sentences: who called, why, and the outcome.

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_number
post_call_analysis_data.description: Callback number the caller gave, if stated.

post_call_analysis_data.name: company_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: Home warranty company the caller represents, only for warranty company calls.
post_call_analysis_data.conditional_prompt: Only for calls from a home warranty company.

post_call_analysis_data.name: service_address
post_call_analysis_data.description: Service address for the repair, if stated.

post_call_analysis_data.name: appliance_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: Appliance type, e.g. refrigerator, dryer, dishwasher.

post_call_analysis_data.name: issue_description
post_call_analysis_data.description: What the appliance is doing or the job details.
post_call_analysis_data.conditional_prompt: Only for repair and warranty company calls.

post_call_analysis_data.name: service_fee_accepted
post_call_analysis_data.description: Whether the caller clearly agreed to the $99 service call fee.
post_call_analysis_data.conditional_prompt: Only for standard, non-warranty customer calls.

post_call_analysis_data.name: booked
post_call_analysis_data.description: Whether a service call was successfully booked through the booking tool.

post_call_analysis_data.name: notes
post_call_analysis_data.description: Any other useful detail the office should know, if stated.
